decisions.reason: The DPA management tool is cheap to maintain as software close to the core offer and supports the firm's compliance direction, and early agency feedback is positive, so the option is worth keeping open while its value resolves.

As the flagship platform shown on the home page and central to the agency-focused strategy, it is a core commitment rather than a marginal option, and nothing so far signals that its value will fail to materialize.
The configurable managed plan runs on existing owned infrastructure at little extra cost and is still too new to judge, so keeping the option open is the sensible choice.
